intro: FFX-2 only. Rikku and Paine have no Songstress painting yet, so a spherechange to Songstress shows a grey mannequin (PR-0228). Bailey delegated the pick to the driver on 2026-09-28 (D-281, "Your pick (Recommended)"): the recommended option per girl is installed and the other options stay saved so Bailey can swap. Everything here is original art (Animagine XL 4.0 Opt; the only image input is our own shipped idle's head crop). The costume words come only from written sources: FF Wiki Songstress revid 3972937 and Final Fantasy X-2 victory poses revid 3955034 (research/visual-bible.md section 1.24). Each option shows its pilot at battle size in Chapter VI (1600x900, the other two girls in their shipped paintings; the girl is re-dressed with the stage's own spherechange path, a labelled staging step), the pilot as a cut-out, and every pilot rendered for it (the green frame is the one shown above).
footer: Candidates with a .prov.json each: D:/Tools/pyrefly-art-backup/candidates/2026-09-29-songstress/options/<option>/. Battle frames: staged at Chapter VI's first command menu on a production build served with the option's idle as an override; nothing was written to public/art for this page.

rikku.title: Rikku
rikku.source: Written costume: an orange sleeveless top with white back ruffles and a purple tie; a short purple skirt with a white belt; orange knee-high boots and orange elbow-length gloves, both with purple feathers; black ribbons on the upper arms and thighs; a purple headband; a green microphone. Victory: a dance that ends with her fist lowered to her chest.
rikku.why: It keeps the bent-forward, hand-on-hip stance of her shipped Thief idle, so she still reads as Rikku from across the field, and it holds still the way a standing loop must (B sings all fight long; C stands on one leg). Every written item is there: purple headband, orange top with the purple tie, purple skirt with the white belt, orange feathered gloves and knee boots, black arm and thigh ribbons, green microphone held low like Yuna's Songstress idle. B and C are not wasted: her cast (singing, microphone up) and victory (hand to her chest) poses carry their ideas.

paine.title: Paine
paine.source: Written costume: a long-sleeved, high-collared white jacket with turquoise lining and rim; turquoise glovelets held on by black studded straps; a black bikini top under the jacket; long tight white pants with silver chains around the thighs; brown high-heeled boots with turquoise ruffles; a teal microphone. Victory: she turns around and lifts her arm above her head. Design note: split between rock 'n' roll and Top 40.
paine.why: It is her Warrior idle's language (three-quarter, weight on one leg, the microphone held low at her side the way she holds her sword, the free hand in her pocket), which is the rock half of the design note and the calmest loop of the three. The white high-collared jacket with turquoise lining over the black bikini top, the tight white pants and the brown heels are all there; the engine mirrors her to face the enemy. C's raised arm is her written victory pose, so her victory painting takes that pose instead of her standing one.

rikku-A.label: A. Showtime stance
rikku-A.line1: Leaning forward with a grin, one hand on her hip, the green microphone low at her side: her Thief idle's stance in the Songstress costume.
rikku-A.line2: Our estimate where the text is silent: the shade of orange, the headband's width. Weak spots: the boots carry little of the purple feather trim; blue and white strands mix into the headband at one side.

rikku-B.label: B. Singing
rikku-B.line1: Microphone at her mouth, the other arm flung out toward the enemy; the white ruffles and black thigh ribbon read best here.
rikku-B.line2: A singing idle would sing through every enemy turn, and a blue ribbon streamer at her hip is not in the text. The first three pilots knelt ("one knee bent"); pilots 5 to 7 stand.

rikku-C.label: C. Dance finish
rikku-C.line1: One knee up, hand to her chest, microphone in the other hand: the end of her written victory dance.
rikku-C.line2: Lively, but a standing loop on one leg looks unsteady, and her hair ribbons fly wide of the body. Pilot 3 grew feathered wings ("purple feathers" taken too far).

paine-A.label: A. Cool stance
paine-A.line1: Three-quarter, microphone held low at her side like her Warrior sword, free hand in her pocket: stern and still.
paine-A.line2: The painting faces left and the engine mirrors it (facing "left" in the sidecar). Weak spots: a red-orange stripe on one sleeve, and the silver thigh chains read as a patterned seam.

paine-B.label: B. Singing
paine-B.line1: Eyes shut, microphone at her mouth, hand on her hip: the Top 40 half of the design note.
paine-B.line2: A singing idle would sing all fight; the jacket grows into a long coat tail with a blue lining, which the text does not describe.

paine-C.label: C. Arm raised
paine-C.line1: The microphone lifted high above her head, the other hand on her hip: her written victory pose.
paine-C.line2: Strong, but a raised arm held through a whole fight reads as a victory already won; her victory painting takes this pose instead.
